topic: Request-pane sub-tabs container: a per-request-tab switcher strip (Params, Auth, Headers, Body, Tests, Code) with count/indicator badges derived from the active RequestSpec; renders the selected panel into a slot but implements no panel itself.
verbatim_prompt: The request-pane sub-tabs container for an HTTP client's request editor. Below the request bar sits a horizontal strip of sub-tabs — Params, Auth, Headers, Body, Tests, Code — each with an optional count/indicator badge; selecting one shows that editor panel in the area below and hides the others. It is a pure container/switcher: it owns which sub-tab is active (per request tab) and renders the slotted panel, but it does NOT implement any of the panels themselves — Params/Headers are a key-value editor, Auth an auth panel, Body a body editor, Code a snippet generator, each delivered as its own component that mounts into a slot here. Read the active request tab's RequestSpec to derive the badges (e.g. params count, headers count, whether auth is set) but do not mutate it. Reuse the existing tab/sub-tab primitive conventions from specs/002-tabs-primitive where applicable rather than inventing a new tab mechanism, and sit inside the request pane provided by specs/003-app-shell (PaneSplit), below the RequestBar from specs/009-request-bar. Visual fidelity is MANDATORY: design/reference.html is the VISUAL TARGET to match to pixel parity, and the exact resolved values are pre-extracted in design/styles.css (:root + [data-theme=dark]) and design/mintenvoy-design-fidelity-contract.md (section Pane tabs — .pane-tab height/gap/colour/weight, .badge + active-badge) — use those exact computed-style values as the fidelity AC targets, treating var(--token) as resolves-to-token (not a literal hex) and color-mix(...) at token level. Copy the VALUES, never the CODE: the export carries generated cruft (data-om-* attributes, __OmT wrappers, inline styles, a tweaks-panel) that must NOT enter the build — rebuild with semantic class names bound to tokens.css. (Do NOT read tokens.json for values — it is reference-only and can drift; design/styles.css is authoritative.)

functional_scope.value: Per-request-tab container/switcher rendering all 6 fixed sub-tabs (Params, Auth, Headers, Body, Tests, Code) in a strip from day one — visible, switchable, keyboard-nav, per contract §6; matches reference (unbuilt ones NOT hidden). Each sub-tab is ONE slot-condition: mounts the panel if provided, else a neutral empty-state (not four throwaway 'coming soon' components). Params/Headers slots receive KVTable (from 014); Auth/Body/Tests/Code slots empty until T8/T7/Tests/T9 land and pass their panel into the slot with zero T5d change. Badges are independent of panel existence: they read the active RequestSpec (params count, headers count, auth-set indicator) — data already carried by 004/014 — so e.g. Auth badge can show 'set' before AuthPanel exists. Net: 6 sub-tabs always visible; 2 slots wired (KVTable x2); 4 empty-state; panels self-insert later.

users.value: Human end-user (developer building/testing HTTP requests) is the SOLE interactive consumer — click/keyboard switch, read badges. Downstream panels (T7 Body/T8 Auth/T9 Code) + 003 shell are COMPOSITION consumers (supply slots / host T5d), not runtime drivers. BUT one programmatic driver in v1: the setActiveSubTab store action. active-sub-tab lives in tabsStore as a PUBLIC action, so selection can be driven programmatically, not only by a click in T5d. Realistic v1 caller: 'open request in tab' flows (collections-tree/history/command-palette, T18/T19/T20) may open a request on a specific sub-tab by writing setActiveSubTab directly. So T5d is NOT the sole writer of its own state — it's a VIEW over a store field that can change externally, and must REACT to external setActiveSubTab (strip + visible panel update) exactly as to its own click (same invariant as KVTable reacting to external RequestSpec mutation). Scope line: T5d IN for reacting to ANY activeSubTab change (own click OR external write); OUT for implementing the jump-flows themselves (live in T18/T19/T20). Explicitly OUT of v1: deep-links/URL-scheme sub-tab nav (no URL routing in local app); command-palette 'jump to Auth tab' action (future consumer, would just call setActiveSubTab — T5d reactivity ready but doesn't build it); any test-harness/automation API (local few-devs app, CTs drive component directly).

inputs_outputs.value: IN: (a) active tab's RequestSpec (read-only -> badge values: params count, headers count, auth-set) — badges exist ONLY for sub-tabs where RequestSpec has something to show (params/headers count, auth-set are real; Body/Tests/Code badges only if RequestSpec carries that data, Code likely none) — NOT a badge per each of the 6. (b) the tab's active-sub-tab field from tabsStore. (c) the 6 panel nodes/slots from parent (Params/Headers = KVTable, other 4 = empty-state). (f) active tab identity (activeTabId from tabsStore) — needed to read the right per-tab active-sub-tab and to write setActiveSubTab(tabId,key); T5d reads both activeTabId and activeSubTab[activeTabId]. (g) theme via data-theme (CSS not JS, not a prop) — T5d renders under active theme, tokens resolve per-theme; why the per-theme fidelity contract binds badge/underline colors in light AND dark. OUT: (d) a single tabsStore write — setActiveSubTab(tabId,key) on tab click/keyboard select, written DIRECTLY to the store (not via parent callback); (e) rendered strip + visible panel. No upward events: (d) is T5d's ONLY write; active-sub-tab is T5d's own per-request state in tabsStore, so T5d owns the read+write loop; parent only supplies panel slots (c) and never learns of sub-tab changes (reinforced by non-goal #6 mount-all/no-lazy — parent has no reason to react to a switch).

integration_points.value: State: activeSubTab: 'params'|'auth'|'headers'|'body'|'tests'|'code' (default 'params') as ONE enum field on the per-tab record in src/renderer/src/lib/tabsStore.ts — same pattern as tab title field. Survives tab switches (A->B->A restores A's sub-tab; local tabId-keyed state would lose it on unmount) and rides future persistence (T23 reopen) for free. Structure: new src/renderer/src/components/organisms/RequestSubTabs.tsx COMPOSING src/renderer/src/components/molecules/Tabs.tsx (002 primitive) — NOT extending it. Tabs = domain-agnostic HOW-to-switch (roving tabindex, keyboard nav, underline); RequestSubTabs = domain organism WHAT-to-switch + WHAT-to-show (RequestSpec badges, slotted panels, activeSubTab read/write via tabsStore). Sits inside request pane (PaneSplit, 003 app-shell) below RequestBar (009). Params/Headers slots receive KVTable (014). Badge source: src/renderer/src/lib/requestSpec.ts (RequestSpec + Auth). Name RequestSubTabs (matches component inventory/task note).

constraints.value: (a) Zero new runtime deps — non-negotiable. Composes existing Tabs molecule + tabsStore + slots from current stack; a new dep = red flag (means Tabs not reused). (b) a11y inherited not reinvented: tablist/tab roles, roving tabindex, arrow/Home/End nav ALREADY in Tabs (002) — T5d must NOT re-implement. T5d's a11y = WIRING: role='tabpanel' per slot, aria-controls/aria-labelledby linking tab<->panel, aria-selected mirroring store activeSubTab. Unbuilt sub-tabs (Auth/Body/Tests/Code) are NOT disabled — valid tabs leading to a non-empty-ARIA empty-state (hiding breaks §6 fixed 6-tab set). WCAG 2.1 AA contrast free from already-AA tokens. (c) State-preservation constraint (NOT latency budget): sub-tab switch must NOT destroy panel state (KVTable cell focus, scroll, half-typed row) — keep all 6 panels mounted and toggle visibility via CSS, NOT unmount/remount inactive slots. Mount-all DOM cost acceptable (2 real KVTables + 4 empty). Non-negotiable: switch preserves panel state + no remount reflow. Plus mandatory visual fidelity: pixel-parity reference.html §6, exact styles.css values, semantic classes->tokens.css, no exported cruft (data-om-*/__OmT/inline/tweaks-panel).

non_goals.value: OUT (7): #1 implementing panel bodies (KVTable exists; Authorization/Body/Tests/Code panels are separate features) — BUT T5d DOES build the slot each panel mounts into (slot = prop/ReactNode from outside; T5d never imports T7/T8/T9). 'No panel bodies' != 'no slots'. #2 reorderable/closable/addable sub-tabs, overflow menus, per-sub-tab context actions (fixed 6-tab set). #3 mutating RequestSpec (method/url/params/headers/authorization/body) — badges read-only; BUT T5d is NOT write-free: it writes the active-sub-tab selection to the tab record (its own state). #4 persistence across restart (T23) — BUT the active-sub-tab selection surviving tab switches within a session is IN (free via tabsStore field). #5 per-sub-tab dirty/validation indicators beyond the count/set badges RequestSpec implies. #6 lazy/on-demand/code-split panel mounting — decision is mount-all + toggle-visibility to preserve panel state; lazy would reintroduce remount-on-switch and lose KVTable edit state (OUT even though it looks like an optimization). #7 sub-tab overflow/responsive collapse — no overflow menu on narrow panes; fixed 6 tabs shrink/scroll horizontally via Tabs molecule's existing behavior; no responsive re-layout.

success_criteria.value: (1) all 6 sub-tabs render + switch via click AND keyboard (arrows/Home/End), active state per-request-tab. Split out: 'survives A->B->A' gets own CT with explicit assert (two tabs, A on Headers, B on Body, switch A->B->A, assert A's activeSubTab==='headers') — catches per-tab-vs-global-state bug. (2) badges reflect live RequestSpec counts (params/headers/auth-set); hard AC = mutate RequestSpec (add a param) -> badge count updates REACTIVELY without a sub-tab switch (not read-once-on-mount). (3) CRITICAL: Params/Headers show KVTable, other 4 empty-state, switch preserves KVTable state proven by: focus a cell/type partial row in Params -> switch Headers -> back -> assert focus/input survived (same DOM node) — defends mount-all vs lazy-mount regression. (4) visual fidelity: computed-style CT vs contract §6 values, EXACT equality for discrete tokens (color/weight/radius = token-resolved exact, ±1px only for subpixel), in BOTH themes (assert under data-theme='dark' too); read §6 numbers from styles.css at CT-writing time not spec snapshot (staleness). (5) a11y: axe zero-violations on mounted T5d, PLUS CT axe can't catch: aria-selected tracks activeSubTab on switch, aria-controls/aria-labelledby point to real ids. (6) empty-slot sub-tabs are FULL tabs NOT disabled — assert all 6 reachable/focusable and unbuilt 4 render valid empty-state tabpanel (guards §6 fixed-6-set vs 'disable unbuilt' shortcut). (7) NEGATIVE AC: sub-tab interaction mutates RequestSpec zero times (spy updateActiveSpec; only write is setActiveSubTab). (8) STRUCTURAL AC: T5d imports no unbuilt panel component; slots are props (grep/lint assert) — lets T5d build now while T7/T8/T9 don't exist.

edge_cases.value: (a) no active tab (empty workspace) — MUST handle: render neutral/empty, no crash on undefined activeTabId. IN. (c) huge counts — real but low-priority (params/headers realistically <50); cheap format guard (>99 -> '99+'), one ternary not a project. (d) rapid keyboard switching — CT-worthy but no special mechanism: activeSubTab is one synchronous store field, no tearing by construction; assert final-state determinism, don't build race handling. (e) generalized slot-null: NOT Params-specific — slot contract is uniform, ANY of 6 slots with null/undefined child -> empty-state (same path as the 4 unbuilt panels); one invariant not a special-case. (f)+(b) absent OR invalid active-sub-tab value: read as VALID_KEYS.includes(v) ? v : 'params' — catches undefined (new/untouched tab) AND present-but-invalid (garbage / future corrupted T23 restore); pre-hardens the T23 corrupted-persisted case without implementing T23. (g) malformed/partial RequestSpec — badge reads defensive (spec.params?.length ?? 0, auth optional); tolerate spec missing arrays/fields -> show 0 / no badge, don't crash (same graceful-degradation class as validVars-empty seam). (h) tab switch mid inline-edit — switching must NOT force-commit/cancel an open inline-edit in a panel; mount-all + hide (display:none) preserves it in place (part of preserves-panel-state AC, not a separate mechanism).

intake_classifications.statement: A per-request-tab sub-tabs strip (Params, Auth, Headers, Body, Tests, Code) with count/indicator badges derived read-only from the active RequestSpec; a pure container/switcher that owns the active sub-tab and renders the slotted panel but implements none of the panels themselves.
